name: Brooklyn Animal Action (BAA)
notes:
All-volunteer 501(c)(3), founded 2010. TNR + adoption + rescuer support/education. No shelter; foster-based. Provides tools/advice so residents can help animals themselves. adopt@ confirmed on own adoptable-pets page.

All-volunteer 501(c)(3) since 2010, ACC New Hope partner. Primarily a cat and TNR organization that has also rehomed some dogs and can pull dogs as a New Hope partner - included with that note. Foster-based, no shelter. For dogs, confirm current availability. Mailing 626 2nd Ave-area, Brooklyn 11215. Intake: Foster/adopt via site Intake: email preferred

It does not take in owned pets: its own site says it is not a shelter and points owners to rehoming a pet themselves. Good for adopting, fostering and TNR help.

change_log.note: Its own rehoming page says it is "not a shelter and do[es] not have a physical location" and sends owners to rehome pets themselves. The surrender tag came from the word "rehoming" in its description. Reviewer noted the same.
